T2.notes: edited in place; tree before/after in the log

T3.notes: Governing: tension across layers at the lower motor-hole rims on the back face (rim 15.12 MPa, sf 1.49), factor under 2.0 at all three sizes (1.61, 1.57, 1.49). Not converged: vm -9% and layer +5.5% at the last step, so the printed factors are not a converged value; the fail does not depend on that. Load two ways: remote bore load gives layer 13.35 at el 2.2 vs 14.33 for pads (pads govern). Support two ways: washers 14.40 vs walls 14.33 at el 2.2. Shear between Z layers 7.25 MPa, sf 1.79.

T4.how_judged: The sharp corner does not converge (series A, control 1.0/0.5/0.25 mm: 20.45, 28.51, 37.75 MPa von Mises, compressive, climbing), so it was judged with the 0.4 mm radius a printed corner has; that converged to 40.05 MPa von Mises (compressive, sigma_z -34.8 MPa) over controls 0.3/0.2/0.13 mm (38.11, 39.66, 40.05; last step 1.0%). Averages at the R0.4 corner over 0.5/1/2 mm at the 0.13 mm mesh: 19.6/16.7/14.7 MPa with 760/2527/6605 nodes.
T4.notes: Lowest factor 0.57 (shear between Z layers at the R0.4 corner, 22.63 MPa, converged); layer factor at the motor holes 1.57 in T4's own rows; hand value 39.3 MPa by curved-beam theory (factor 3.57). Whole part fails on two counts: tension across layers at the lower motor-hole rims (sf 1.49, the T3 governing measure, unchanged by the corner) and von Mises at the R0.4 corner (40.05 MPa, sf on yield 1.12). Series B converged; series A did not (expected for a sharp compressive corner). Hand estimate for the R0.4 corner was about 24 MPa (11 MPa nominal x Kt 2.2); the study gives 40 MPa, 67% above. Not explained; the Kt that the study implies is about 3.2 on sigma_z. Not resolved here.

T5.change: Two 3.5 mm ribs between upright and base at the Y edges (legs 28 mm, 3.5 mm thick), and printed on its side (layers along Y).
T5.print_orientation: on its side: face Y 0 on the bed, layers stacked along Y
T5.rounded_toes: R2.0 on the four rib corners (base and upright), follow-up R1, run t5_toe.py, rows in t5_toe_rows.json, judge in t5_toe_judge.json. Finest (1.6 mm, 194,421 nodes): vm 13.54 MPa, layer 7.52, shear 3.98 (Y table). Converged on all three: last steps 2.2 %, 0.7 %, 1.5 %. Lowest factor 2.99 (layer, converged). Peak von Mises moved to the upright toe at z 33.7, not the base root.
T5.notes: Verdict from judge() on the rounded-toe series (follow-up R1): pass, every entry converged, lowest factor 2.99 (layer tension across Y layers). The earlier result before the toe radius was margin, not converged (von Mises 3.60 moving +13 % per step, 2.81 after two more); with the R2.0 toe the von Mises converges at 13.54 MPa (factor 3.32). Mass 42.48 g, +8.25 %, within the 10 % limit. Factors at the finest rib study (el 1.6, 190,958 nodes) for layers along Y: von Mises 3.6 (peak 12.51 MPa at the rib-leg end on the base top, X 34 Y 49 Z 6), layer 3.02, shear 3.24. All three measures pass 2.0, but von Mises is not converged: 10.68 / 11.06 / 12.51 MPa over el 3.0/2.2/1.6 (+13% at the last step), at a sharp rib-leg edge. Under the playbook rule a pass needs every measure converged, so the verdict is recorded as fail with status 'not shown', not pass. A rib-end radius would settle it; the von Mises stress would have to rise about 80% (to 22.5 MPa) before this part fails. Layer and shear converged (<5%). Step 2a (same geometry on its side) was not re-solved: the Y reading of T3_PADS_16 (layer 8.41, shear 7.24, vm 19.12) fails on shear (sf 1.79), so the ribs were needed. Printing note: the rib legs lie in the layer plane when printed on its side, but the upper rib is in mid-air over the base and needs support under it.

T6.how_pin_was_stabilised: two soft pads (Ø3 x 1.5 mm, modulus 0.5 MPa) bonded to the pin end faces, their outer faces fixed, clear of the block; they carried 0.20 N of 500 N at full load (0.04%)

matched_mesh.source: follow-up R2b, t6m.py, rows in t6m_rows.json; same model, control on the pin set equal to the hole control

T6.why: Valid after R2 (matched mesh): reaction -500.0 N, block -499.8 N, pads -0.2 N, pin rise 0.129 mm, line mean within 25 % of 6.76 MPa and converged over three sizes. Earlier (before R2) it was judged not valid: mid-length contact pressure 6.77 MPa at the finest hole control (0.5 mm, 122,007 nodes), against the 6.8 MPa Hertz line-contact value (within 25%), and the peak bearing stress over the hole is 6.77 MPa at (0.02, 2.88, 15.1). Not valid: the series does not converge: mid-length pressure 6.52 / 5.96 / 6.77 MPa over controls 1.2/0.8/0.5 (last step +13.6%) and the peak over the hole 6.71 / 6.23 / 6.77 (+8.7%). Reaction -500.0 N and block-side contact force -499.8 N, pads 0.20 N. Pin rise 0.130 mm, inside the 0.10-0.14 window. Proof run at 0.25 N per end: rise 0.100 mm, i.e. 0.1% of the load gives 77% of the full rise, so the set is contact, not a bond. Check 3 failed: lig_force 1053-1820 N against the planned 400-650 N window (node mean; reads high near the hole, not investigated). The proof run carried 0.15 N of 0.5 N in the pads (30%), so at that size the pads are not negligible.
T6.notes: Series converged for contact_vm only (last step +3.3%); p_mid and p_all did not converge. Fallback A (PIN_Z 10.09) not run: the gap closed at the first load and checks 1 to 4 did not need it. Block peak von Mises 5.33 MPa at (-2.07, 15, 16.06), on the mouth edge at the back face Y 15.
